code:

title: Conditional in Comprehension Filter vs Map
code:
nums = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
evens = [x for x in nums if x % 2 == 0]
transformed = [x if x % 2 == 0 else -x for x in nums]
print(evens)
print(transformed)

title: Walrus in Comprehension
code:

print(results)

title: re.compile for Repeated Patterns
code:

for text in ['abc123', 'no digits', '42']:
    print(pattern.findall(text))

title: Greedy vs Non-Greedy Regex
code: import re html = 'bolditalic' greedy = re.findall(r'<.+>', html) non_greedy = re.findall(r'<.+?>', html) print(greedy) print(non_greedy)

title: Named Capture Groups
code:
import re
m = re.match(r'(?P<year>\d{4})-(?P<month>\d{2})-(?P<day>\d{2})', '2024-06-15')
print(m.group('year'), m.group('month'), m.group('day'))

title: Lookahead and Lookbehind
code:
import re
text = '100USD 200EUR 300GBP'
matches = re.findall(r'\d+(?=USD)', text)
print(matches)
